pages.description: Enjoy a unique glamping holiday fit for family and friends in the East Neuk of Fife.
pages.text:
Home page
Enjoy the excitement of sleeping under canvas with all the comforts of home in a unique location in the East Neuk of Fife
find out more
The perfect base for exploring the coastline.  Watch the sunrise over the sea, toast marshmallows by the fire,  catch a glimpse of a pod of dolphins and fall asleep to the sound of the sea. A place where memories are made.
Catchpenny Safari Lodges are a completely unique way to experience the East Neuk. Situated just meters from the shoreline, on the Fife Coastal Path between the pretty fishing villages of Elie and St Monans. The lodges themselves offer a home-from-home glamping experience with real beds, log burning stove and a hot shower all under canvas. With Elie on their doorstep, the lodges are a perfect base to enjoy all that the East Neuk has to offer.
find out more
Our lodges.
Catchpenny is a collection of 8 luxury safari lodges, each sleeping up to 6 people with uninterrupted views over the Firth of Forth and beyond. The canvas lodges are a far cry from your conventional camping experience. In each lodge you will find comfy beds, a proper shower and toilet, a well equipped kitchen and a log burning stove to keep you cosy in the evening.
find out more
Get close to nature.
Having woken up to the sound of the waves, watch the ever changing sea-scape while you experience life by the water unfold. The lodges provide the perfect base to explore the area’s rich natural habitats. The lodges are a bird watcher’s paradise, with a wealth of sea birds and May Island a short distance away. With the Fife Coastal Path literally on your doorstep, walkers can head off for miles in either direction, as well as many other walks inland that take in places of interest.
find out more
The local area.
Elie is one of the world’s special places. It’s honey coloured beaches, tennis courts, golf courses, deli, farm shop, chain walk and extensive watersports offer unrivalled opportunities for families to enjoy themselves. A variety of family friendly eateries between Elie and St Andrews mean you are never far from a delicious locally sourced meal. The award winning Ardross Farm Shop just 500m walk away will cater for all your culinary needs (including your morning coffee and croissant)

Adding a touch of luxury, style and sophistication to the traditional camping experience, glamping at Catchpenny means you can enjoy the great outdoors with the whole family (including your dog) without compromising on comfort or a good night's sleep.
Escape to nature and enjoy Catchpenny’s quirky accommodation - camping with all of the comforts of home. Staying in one of our luxurious lodges is not only the ultimate holiday getaway, but a unique holiday experience in Scotland which will not be forgotten.
With all the comforts of home such as real beds, excellent quality linen, hot showers and even a flushing loo! The kitchens are well equipped with a two hob gas stove for quick cooking and a wood burning stove for an additional hob and oven. The stove also provides warmth for those slightly chillier evenings. There will be a full basket of logs for your arrival as well as kitchen cleaning products and basics such as tea, coffee, sugar, oil, salt and pepper.
Relax into the sofa and armchairs on the covered deck whilst soaking up the changing sea and sky. Step inside the lodges and there is a large lounge with sofa and dining table, kitchen area with hot water and fridge. There is a king size bed in one area, two single beds in another and an enchanting elevated king size cabin bed which forms the wall between the living area and twin room.
There is a private bathroom at the back of each lodge with a fantastic shower, toilet, basin and heated towel rail. The back corridor has space for storing coats and wellies and all the things that make a seaside holiday a success. We provide all your bed linen, towels and gorgeous natural bathroom products.
We are just back from the most amazing, off-grid experience we could have wished for. I've traveled the world and never felt as relaxed after our trip to Catchpenny Safari Lodges. From start to finish, we were overwhelmed with the facilities offered in our lodge. We used the stove to keep cosy and at the same time cook our garlic bread in the adjoining oven. Our girls loved the cabin bed, The beds and showers are the standard you would find in a 5 star hotel . We zipped open our tent the next morning and we had uninterrupted views of the sea.
We saw a pod of dolphins porpoising right in front of our lodge as a gaggle of geese flew over. - Sensory overload - binoculars are a must. This weekend was the best social distancing holiday we could have wished for and we would highly recommend Catchpenny to anyone looking to get close to nature and the coastal walk is right in front of the lodges. The local farm shop is also a short walk away. Fantastic holiday and we wouldn't have changed a thing. It was always a pleasure speaking with Alex and Tara.
October 2020
The name Catchpenny, or 'Catch-a-Penny' as it sometimes used to be known is the name of a former tavern located close to us between Elie and St Monans.  In the olden days villagers were not allowed to drink alcohol in their villages on a Sunday.  So what did they do? They built a tavern between the villages so they could have a drink on a Sunday!  The tavern unfortunately is long gone but have a look on the map on the ceiling of the Ship Inn in Elie and see if you can spot it!

Located just an hours drive from Edinburgh, Catchpenny sits on the Fife coastal path between the pretty villages of Elie and St Monans in the East Neuk of Fife.
Catchpenny is well connected to the local train network with direct links to Edinburgh, Dundee and Aberdeen from Cupar and Markinch stations.
Leuchars station offers direct trains to and from London. Catchpenny is located just 1 mile from Elie and easily accessed by road or on foot via the Fife Coastal Path.
